senses.gloss: (a comp. of כ a. ד, corresp. to h. כַּאֲשֶׁר or כְּשֶׁ־) when, as, as though.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 119:109">Targ. Ps. CXIX, 109</cite> <he>כיד על גב</he> Ms. (ed. only <he>ע״ג</he>) as though (carried) on &c.; a. v. fr.—
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 29:15">Targ. Is. XXIX, 15</cite> <he>כִּדְבְּקִבְלָא</he> (ed. Lag. <he>כיד בק׳</he>) as though in darkness.
<cite ref="Onkelos Numbers 29:18">Targ. O. Num. XXIX, 18</cite> <he>כדחזי</he>, v. <cite ref="H00526"><he>חֲזִי</he></cite>, as it is proper; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 3:1:5">Y. Ab. Zar. III, 42ᶜ</cite> top.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 7:1:5">Y. Yoma VII, 44ᵇ</cite> top <he>כד דהיא וכ׳</he> when there is &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 1:2:4">Y. Taan. I, 64ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>כד הוינן</he>; Y. Meg. III, 74ᵇ bot. <he>כרי דהוינן</he>, v. <cite ref="N00280"><he>נְהַר</he> I</cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 52a:5">B. Kam. 52ᵃ</cite> (prov.) <he>כד רגיז וכ׳</he> when the shepherd is angry with his flock, he makes a blind sheep the leader.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 64b">Ib. 64ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>כִּדְּאַמְרֵי וכ׳</he> as they say &c.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 64b:7">Ib. 64ᵇ</cite> <he>כִּדְּתָנָא דבי וכ׳</he> as (that which) the scholars of the school of … said.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 64b:21">Ib.</cite> <he>מיבעי ליה לכִדְּתָנִי</he> it is needed for (something like) what has been taught.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 64b:11">Ib.</cite> <he>לְכִדְּרָבָא</he> for what Raba said.
B. Mets. 99ᵇ כדרבא agreeably to what R. said; a. v. fr.—[Num. R. s. 14 א״ת כדרבונות אלא כִּדֵּרַבָּניּת read not (Koh. XII, 11) kaddarbonoth, but kidd’rabbanuth, like a command of authority.]
